'''Michael Patriquin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Phoenix Grand Slam]] on 5 November 2000, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1441">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-10-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3d1441/ phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 10 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-10-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3d1441/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
